description: This is a JUnit test class for the ReadingGoalCalculator component of a book tracking application. It contains tests for calculation methods, schedule adherence logic, and date-related utility functions, specifically verifying the behavior of the ReadingGoalCalculator in different scenarios.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the ReadingGoalCalculator class, testing progress calculations, schedule adherence, and date-related logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up static mocking for DateUtils before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the static mock for DateUtils after all tests.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValue
methods.description: Tests correct calculation of progress towards reading goal.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalMet
methods.description: Tests calculation when the reading goal has been fully achieved.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalExceeded
methods.description: Tests calculation when the number of books read exceeds the goal.

methods.name: testNoProgressMadeTowardsGoal
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no books have been read.

methods.name: notAttemptToDivideByZeroInCalculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Ensures that division by zero is handled gracefully in progress calculation.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowExceptionOnZeroDivision
methods.description: Verifies that no exceptions are thrown when reading progress calculation involves zero.

methods.name: LowerBoundProgressTests.setFirstWeek
methods.description: Mocks week number to 1 (start of year) for testing schedule behind/ ahead calculations.

methods.name: LowerBoundProgressTests.behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule behind calculation at the start of the year.

methods.name: LowerBoundProgressTests.onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule on track at the start of the year.

methods.name: LowerBoundProgressTests.aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule ahead calculation at the start of the year.

methods.name: NormalCaseProgressTests.setWeekToMiddleOfYear
methods.description: Mocks week number to 26 for mid-year schedule calculations.

methods.name: NormalCaseProgressTests.behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule behind case in mid-year scenario.

methods.name: NormalCaseProgressTests.onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule on track mid-year.

methods.name: NormalCaseProgressTests.aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule ahead mid-year.

methods.name: UpperBoundProgressTests.setLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks week number to 52 (end of year) for testing late-year schedule calculations.

methods.name: UpperBoundProgressTests.behindSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule behind at year's end.

methods.name: UpperBoundProgressTests.onSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule on track at year's end.

methods.name: UpperBoundProgressTests.aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Tests schedule ahead at year's end.

methods.name: testBooksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Verifies calculation of proportion of year elapsed based on total books to read.

methods.name: returnFalseInBookHasFinishDateThisYearIfBookIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null book input returns false for date in current year.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookDoesNotHaveAFinishDate
methods.description: Verifies that a book with no finish date returns false.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Helper to create a book instance with default attributes.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookNotReadThisYear
methods.description: Checks that a book finished last year does not count as finished this year.

methods.name: returnTrueIfBookReadThisYear
methods.description: Checks that a book finished this year is recognized as such.
